summary: OAuth callback infrastructure: LocalCallbackServer (ephemeral HTTP server capturing a single OAuth redirect) and manual auth utilities (extract_code_from_input, prompt_for_code).

key_classes.name: LocalCallbackServer
key_classes.summary: Ephemeral HTTPServer on localhost that captures a single OAuth callback. Configurable port (0=ephemeral) and timeout. Exposes .port, .redirect_uri, .wait_for_callback().

key_functions.name: extract_code_from_input
key_functions.summary: Parses user input (URL or bare code) into dict with 'code' and optional 'state'.

key_functions.name: prompt_for_code
key_functions.summary: Prints authorize URL and prompts user for redirect URL or code. Returns parsed dict.

lifecycle_notes: LocalCallbackServer silences request logging (log_message is a no-op)
Server closes after first callback received
documentation_hooks: When to use local_server vs manual redirect mode

evidence.detail: Tests for callback capture, URL parsing, manual code extraction
